description: Minimum surface REDBEAM needs today: window control, the event bus, and path resolution. Filesystem, shell, dialog and http are deliberately NOT granted to the frontend — the folder and drawing pickers run in Rust, where the ACL does not apply, and adding them here would open the whole plugin to the webview. The updater and a single process:allow-restart are granted because an installed copy has no other route to a fix; `process:default` is NOT, since that would also hand the webview the ability to exit the app.
